description: Facies–biozone compatibility matrix for contradiction detection. Encodes B4 Facies Veto doctrine: age interpretation must not violate depositional environment without documented explanation. Sabah-calibrated with NW Borneo margin knowledge.
doctrine: B4 Facies Veto — biostrat-as-calibration, not biostrat-as-constitution

COAL_CARBONACEOUS.note: Nannofossils cannot form in peat/coal. Requires reworking or thin marine incursion.

continental_conglomerate.note: Nannofossils are marine. Fluvial conglomerate is not.

red_bed.note: Oxidizing continental environment — nannofossils not preserved.

freshwater_swamp.note: No marine water. Check for reworking or misidentified facies.

fluvial.note: River systems do not host calcareous nannoplankton.

lacustrine.note: Lacustrine unless connected to marine. Check for freshwater algae instead.

alluvial.note: Terrestrial. Nannofossils require marine water column.

coastal_plain.note: Possible if thin marine incursion, marginal marine, or estuarine connection. Check for forams + marine palynomorphs.

deltaic.note: Delta front/prodelta may have marine influence. Check if nannos occur only in marine-influenced intervals.

estuarine.note: Brackish to marine transition possible. Nannofossil abundance should vary with salinity.

mangrove.note: Mangrove is coastal — marine nannos may co-occur with mangrove pollen during transgression.

COAL_CARBONACEOUS.note: No planktonic forams in peat swamps.

evaporite.note: Hypersaline — no normal marine planktonic forams.

fluvial.note: Transport possible but rare — flag as reworked unless proven otherwise.

coastal_plain.note: May indicate marine incursion. Check for benthic forams + marine palynomorphs.

deltaic.note: Planktonics in delta front suggest marine influence. May be transported.

benthic_foraminifera.note: Benthic forams are more tolerant but still require marine or brackish water.

freshwater_swamp.note: No marine benthic forams in freshwater swamp.

fluvial.note: Some agglutinated forams tolerate brackish — check assemblage composition.

freshwater_swamp.note: Marine dinocysts in freshwater peat = reworking or contamination.

fluvial.note: May indicate marine influence in coastal river. Check abundance and preservation.

palynomorph_terrestrial.note: Terrestrial palynomorphs are not facies-diagnostic for marine vs non-marine. They indicate proximity to land.
palynomorph_terrestrial.caution: Pollen/spore presence alone does NOT prove non-marine conditions. They can be transported far offshore.

open_marine_nannofossils.note: Freshwater algae + marine nannos = fluvial input into marine basin, or reworking. Check proportions.

planktonic_foraminifera.note: Freshwater algae + planktonic forams = mixed signal. Reworking, caving, or fluvial transport into marine.

malay_basin_specific.note: Based on Yakzan et al. integrated zonation. Palynology is backbone — many intervals are non-marine to marginal marine.

coastal_plain_facies.if_present: Check for marine incursion or flooding surface. May be diachronous.

marine_flooding_surfaces.significance: Key correlation surface but may be diachronous across basin margin.

maximum_flooding_surfaces.significance: Most reliable regional correlation surface. Condensed section may concentrate fossils.

sabah_specific.note: NW Sabah margin has accretionary prism material with deep-marine pre-MMU section and post-MMU shelf/slope progradation. Deep Regional Unconformity separates them.

pre_MMU_deep_marine.description: Pre-early Middle Miocene: deep-marine clastics, compressed/imbricated
pre_MMU_deep_marine.caution: Reworking risk high — gravity flows may transport older fossils. Tectonic imbrication may repeat or omit section.

post_MMU_shelf_slope.description: Post-early Middle Miocene: NW-prograding clastic shelf/slope wedge
post_MMU_shelf_slope.caution: Diachronous flooding surfaces. Marine influence arrives at different times in different provinces.

deep_regional_unconformity.biozone_signature: Abrupt biozone gap, missing zones, facies shift from deep marine to shelfal
deep_regional_unconformity.not: Simple time gap — may involve structural overprint

inboard_belt.typical_play: Middle Miocene and younger clastic reservoirs

outboard_belt.typical_play: Middle Miocene and younger clastic reservoirs

crocker_accretionary_prism.biozone_relevance: Highly disturbed — biostrat may be unreliable

constitutional_alignment.F2_TRUTH: Every facies conflict must cite evidence_for AND evidence_against
constitutional_alignment.F4_CLARITY: Separation enforced: observation (fossil seen) vs interpretation (age/environment inferred)
constitutional_alignment.F6_MARUAH: Scientific integrity — contradiction surfaced, not suppressed
constitutional_alignment.F7_HUMILITY: Confidence hard-capped at 0.85 for biostratigraphic claims
